Close to the historic districts and the congress center, the hotel integrates business and leisure. Enjoy your preferred flavors and new discoveries at the Matiz Lisboa restaurant and bar.

Take advantage of the swimming pool on the top floor of the hotel - the perfect place to relax and recharge!
